node.description: A oneOf of 18 FULLY INDEPENDENT node schemas, each with its own complete properties/required/additionalProperties:false. Deliberately not a shared base plus allOf patches: draft-07 evaluates additionalProperties:false only against a schema's OWN properties, so a shared base cannot close properties a sibling branch adds.
